copies.public/_headers: generated by site-runtime-headers from the site's registry entry, the set the Worker applies; the build rewrites it
copies.app/lib/markdown-twin.ts: the post twin's own negotiation: prefersMarkdown goes through the site's prefersType (negotiate.mjs), which every negotiated route shares, and markdownResponse sends Vary: Accept only on the never-stored negotiated variant, so the stored .md twin stays one cache entry
